title: feat: live community numbers on Home
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-up to #16103: Home shows that people are using and building on Pollinations right now. Every number is measured live from a public feed.

- Adds "N requests in the last hour" under the hero CTA (gen `/models/status`, one rollup row per model)
- Adds GitHub Quest totals to the Free credits line, via a cached leaderboard loader now shared with Community
- Adds "Most used this week | Newest" tabs to the Apps shelf (both from the cached app directory)
- Simplifies card copy in Build and Publish (shorter, plainer sentences); the Agents card shows just its count

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Hero | static | 38,272 requests in the last hour |
| Apps | most used only | Most used this week / Newest |

Note: apps listed since Sep 29 have no screenshot yet (screenshots come from manual backfills), so the Newest tab shows placeholders for now.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

https://claude.ai/code/session_01Qv9n8zUKi85ULQDkKt9Use

gist.headline: The garden has a pulse
gist.blurb: Home gets a little less static: an hourly request count, GitHub Quest totals, and a way to browse both popular and newly added apps. The numbers come from public feeds rather than decorative guesswork.
gist.summary: Home adds an hourly request count from gen `/models/status`, GitHub Quest totals from a cached leaderboard shared with Community, and “Most used this week” and “Newest” app tabs backed by the cached app directory.
gist.impact: Visitors get a measured view of Pollinations activity and two ways to explore apps; recently listed apps without backfilled screenshots display placeholders.
gist.visual_concept: Polli checks a cozy garden dashboard: a glowing CRT shows the last-hour request count, a small Quest tally sits beside it, and two labeled paths lead to popular and newest app sprouts. The dashboard and sprouts represent public usage data and the app directory; the newest sprouts can have simple placeholder picture frames.
